events.text: how do I rotate the vault token?
for staging I mean

I’d check the Vault auth method and token policy first, then create a replacement token with the same (or reduced) policy, update every consumer, verify access, and revoke the old token.

For a standard Vault token:
```sh
vault token create -policy=<policy> -ttl=<ttl>
# update secret store / deployment with the new token
vault token revoke <old-token>
```
Use a periodic or renewable token only if the workload’s auth design requires it; prefer workload auth (Kubernetes, AWS, AppRole) over distributing static tokens.
